description: Result of a completed reference-annotation job.

kind.description: Discriminant — every JobResult member carries `kind`, single-valued, so a consumer holding only the result can tell what it is (WIRE-UNION-DISCRIMINANTS D1).

underReportedPieces.description: Total floor-accepted under-reported pieces across the job's units. Absent means none — the per-unit evidence rides the terminal progress frame's completedItems; this keeps the result self-describing without the progress stream.
